mcp.title: MCP connections
mcp.description: Applications you authorized through the Model Context Protocol.
mcp.empty: No applications are connected. Authorize an MCP client to see it here.
mcp.loadFailed: Failed to load your MCP connections.
mcp.revokeDescription: This revokes every authorization for “{{client}}”. Its refresh tokens stop working immediately and it must ask for consent again. You can sign in again later to reauthorize.
mcp.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke this connection. Try again.

tokens.title: Personal MCP tokens
tokens.description: Static tokens for headless MCP clients such as Grok. Paste the secret into the client's Authorization header. Prefer OAuth when a browser is available.
tokens.loadFailed: Failed to load your MCP tokens.
tokens.createDescription: The secret is shown once. Store it in the MCP client config; it cannot be recovered later.
tokens.createDisabled: Token creation is unavailable while MCP is disabled. You can still revoke existing tokens.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.allowWriteHelp: Grants mcp:write in addition to mcp:read. Leave off for read-only clients.
tokens.allowCliCommandsHelp: Lets this token run shell commands on your CLIs through MCP. Requires write access.
tokens.allowCliCommandsNoExpiryWarning: This token never expires and can run commands on your CLIs. Prefer an expiry, or revoke it when you no longer need it.
tokens.expiryHelp: Expiry can be at most 365 days from now. Tokens without expiry stay valid until you revoke them.
tokens.nameInvalid: Use a name between 1 and 120 characters.
tokens.noExpiryDisabled: Tokens without expiry are disabled on this deployment. Choose an expiry date.
tokens.expiryInvalid: That expiry date isn't valid. Pick a future date within 365 days.
tokens.createFailed: Couldn't create this token. Try again.
tokens.capReached: You've reached the limit of active MCP tokens. Revoke one before creating another.
tokens.oneTimeHelp: Copy this now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.mcpUrlHelp: Use this URL with any MCP client that supports Bearer authentication.
tokens.grokConfigHelp: Add this to ~/.grok/config.toml. Prefer an environment variable instead of pasting the secret into a committed file.
tokens.revokeDescription: “{{name}}” will stop working immediately. Create a new token if you need access again.
tokens.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke this token. Try again.
